title: Towards Automatic Evaluation for Image Transcreation
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured the performance of Vision-Language Models on transcreating images from the abstract category of 'religion'. Performance was evaluated along three axes: cultural relevance, semantic equivalence, and visual similarity.
findings: VLM-based metrics performed well on cultural relevance for the religion category. However, both object-based metrics and VLM-based metrics struggled to evaluate semantic equivalence for abstract categories like religion. Embedding-based metrics also showed slightly diminished performance for abstract categories compared to concrete ones.
